description:
We are a creative team passionate about space exploration, technology, and innovation. Our project, Hydra Guard, is a smart device designed to monitor astronauts' dehydration, provide hydration alerts, and support water recovery during space missions.

We welcome enthusiastic members interested in hardware, AI, software, data analysis, design, and human space exploration to collaborate and help make space missions safer and more sustainable.
summary:
Hydra Guard is a smart system designed to support astronauts’ health and well-being during space missions by addressing dehydration and water management challenges.

The system combines a smart device, a proposed water recovery concept, and a mobile application. The device uses a smart camera to analyze potential indicators of dehydration, while temperature and humidity sensors monitor environmental conditions. It provides visual and audio alerts when potential dehydration or environmental changes are detected.

The mobile application presents hydration indicators, environmental readings, water availability, and alerts through an accessible interface, helping astronauts monitor their status.

Additionally, the proposed water recovery concept explores hydrogen fuel cell technology to produce water and a heating unit to convert water into vapor.

Hydra Guard aims to promote astronauts’ health, improve water management, and support safer and more sustainable long-duration space missions.
details:
Hydra Guard is a smart health monitoring software concept designed to support astronauts' health and well-being during space missions, with a particular focus on hydration monitoring and environmental conditions.

The system combines a mobile application concept with a smart monitoring device. A smart camera explores potential visual indicators associated with dehydration, while temperature and humidity sensors monitor the surrounding environment. The software brings these indicators together in a clear dashboard, allowing astronauts to view monitoring information, track environmental readings, and receive visual and audio alerts when potential changes are detected.

The project aims to improve health awareness, support early attention to potential dehydration indicators, and help astronauts monitor environmental conditions during long-duration space missions.

The proposed solution combines software design, mobile application development concepts, camera-based monitoring, and environmental sensing technologies. The mobile application prototype was designed using Figma to demonstrate the user interface and main features.

What makes Hydra Guard creative is its integration of health-related indicators and environmental monitoring within one astronaut-focused platform. The team considered the challenges of space missions, ease of use, accessibility, clear information presentation, and the importance of timely alerts.

Hydra Guard is designed as a decision-support concept and does not replace medical diagnosis. Its goal is to contribute to safer and more sustainable human space exploration.
